title: The Note in the Library Window
synopsis: Kim and Sue find a note inviting homemade books to the Market Street library and remember Ben's completed Book of Little Sounds.
continuity_state: Before: Season ten is complete; Ben's blue six-page Book of Little Sounds remains on the Story House low shelf. Kim knows Market Street library from season nine, and Sue knows its clock. Garden has one open sunflower, one bud. After: Kim and Sue learn that the Market Street library will host a small Sunday afternoon table for homemade books. The librarian invites Ben's book only if Ben agrees; no promise has yet been made. The book remains untouched on the Story House shelf. Sue retains her green star cushion, Kim her three pebbles, and both return home with grown-ups.
